source.author: verg
source.text: Ceu saevum turba leonem cum telis premit infensis, at territus ille, asper, acerba tuens, retro redit, et neque terga ira dare aut virtus patitur, nec tendere contra ille quidem hoc cupiens potis est per tela virosque:
source.text_original: Ceu saevum turba leonem / cum telis premit infensis, at territus ille, / asper, acerba tuens, retro redit, et neque terga / ira dare aut virtus patitur, nec tendere contra / ille quidem hoc cupiens potis est per tela virosque: /
source.text_english: As when a crowd with hostile weapons presses a savage lion, yet he, terrified, fierce, glaring savagely, falls back, and neither anger nor courage allows him to turn his back, nor, though desiring this, is he indeed able to press forward against the weapons and the men:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tum iuvenem tranquilla tuens nec fronte timendus occupat et fictis dat vultum et pondera dictis.
reuse.text_original: tum iuvenem tranquilla tuens nec fronte timendus / occupat et fictis dat vultum et pondera dictis.
reuse.text_english: then, gazing upon the youth with a calm expression that gave no cause for fear, he takes him in, and lends both countenance and weight to his feigned words.
